errors.message: line 4: write it as "tell porch blackout" (a board's name, then one of its effects) or "tell porch pixel_speed = 150" (a setting).
line 5: write it as "tell porch blackout" (a board's name, then one of its effects) or "tell porch pixel_speed = 150" (a setting).
line 6: "porch_2" is not a board's name. Use the name the board has on the network (letters, digits and -, as in porch.local), or all.
line 7: "-porch" is not a board's name. Use the name the board has on the network (letters, digits and -, as in porch.local), or all.
line 8: "broadcast" is not a board's name. Use the name the board has on the network (letters, digits and -, as in porch.local), or all.
line 9: "an effect name that is far too long to send" cannot be sent as an effect's name: it has at most 32 characters, and no / or +.
line 10: "fog/on" cannot be sent as an effect's name: it has at most 32 characters, and no / or +.
line 11: "pixel speed" is not a setting's name. A setting is one word of letters, digits and _, for example pixel_speed.
line 12: "9lives" is not a setting's name. A setting is one word of letters, digits and _, for example pixel_speed.
line 13: wifi_pass cannot be changed by another board: its name, passwords, Wi-Fi, MQTT, board link, page lock, remote trigger and built-in effect stay with the board.
line 14: remote_trigger_enable cannot be changed by another board: its name, passwords, Wi-Fi, MQTT, board link, page lock, remote trigger and built-in effect stay with the board.
line 15: say the value, for example "tell porch pixel_speed = 150".
line 16: the value is longer than 64 characters.
line 17: write it as "tell porch blackout" (a board's name, then one of its effects) or "tell porch pixel_speed = 150" (a setting).
